settings.intro: From the first request to final delivery coordination, every custom project moves through clear review, quote, approval, payment, production, and delivery stages.
settings.step_one_text: Send your request with the piece, room, rough dimensions, references, or photos you want us to review. Our team reviews the brief and responds within 24-48 business hours.
settings.step_two_text: We discuss the details by email, phone, or WhatsApp, then prepare the proposed dimensions, finish direction, project scope, and tailored quote for your approval.
settings.step_three_text: Once every detail feels right, we send a secure payment link for your order. After payment and final approval, our artisans begin crafting your piece. We keep you updated through proof review, final confirmation, and delivery coordination.
settings.assurance_text: Custom and made-to-order pieces can only be changed or cancelled where permitted by policy, so we confirm key details before production, preparation, or fulfillment begins.

settings.description: Share your ideas and space details before ordering. Our complimentary consultation helps define dimensions, wood direction, finish, scope, quote, and next steps.
settings.request_placeholder: Tell us about your project, room, dimensions, finish direction, budget range, timeline, and any references you want us to review.
settings.security_text: Your information is secure and will only be used to respond to your consultation request. We respond within 24-48 business hours.
settings.success_message: Thank you. Your consultation request has been sent. We respond within 24-48 business hours.

settings.question: What can be customized?
settings.answer: Custom commissions may include adjusted dimensions, finish direction, wood selection, custom forms, and project-specific design details. The final scope is confirmed with you before production begins.

settings.question: How is pricing determined for a custom piece?
settings.answer: Every proposal is prepared individually. Pricing reflects the scale of the piece, wood selection, design complexity, finish, and any delivery or specialized service requirements. After the complimentary consultation, we provide a project scope, detailed specification, and tailored quotation for approval.

settings.question: Which materials and finishes can I choose from?
settings.answer: WRYDECO works with solid natural wood selected for grain, strength, and character. Available wood and finish directions are reviewed during consultation so they support the form, intended use, and atmosphere of your space.

settings.question: How long does a bespoke commission take?
settings.answer: Timing depends on design complexity, material sourcing, handcrafting, finishing, approvals, and project logistics. We establish the expected schedule after reviewing your brief and keep the process clear from proof approval through final photos or video confirmation before packing.

settings.question: How are delivery and installation planned?
settings.answer: Standard shipping is coordinated to eligible destinations worldwide. Any specialized delivery, placement, assembly, installation, or storage service is reviewed separately and confirmed in writing before it is arranged.
